info.description: The Branch Data Subject Request API supports our customers with two key components of data protection laws like the General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) - the right to access personal data and the right to request deletion of personal data (also known as the right be forgotten).
